query:
UPDATE eval.bundles
    SET status = $2,
        gate_run_id = COALESCE($3, gate_run_id),
        override_reason = COALESCE($4, override_reason),
        promoted_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'live' THEN now()
                           WHEN $2 = 'live_ungated' THEN COALESCE(promoted_at, now())
                           ELSE promoted_at END
  WHERE id = $1
